svg.text: One Compose project (scenarios/edc-interop/compose.yaml): the data space's portitor-issuer, a Portitor participant, an EDC v1.0.0-RC8 participant, the EDC Issuer Service as a second issuer, and a local Gaia-X compliance
service in test mode (examples/gaiax/compliance.yaml). The tls service answers for the *.gaiax.test names over HTTPS with a test CA made for each run.
One machine [Docker, or rootless Podman, with Docker Compose]
DID document, credential service, Identity API
serves the EDC provider's data; pulls from
HTTPS for *.gaiax.test, with the run's test CA; DID
the key set of the Identity API tokens
